scope: Nagoya TV Tower in April 2011, with silver steel legs and tapering lattice, the elevated lower floors, enclosed viewing deck, open upper balcony and broadcast antenna arrays.

originalReview.notes: The long view shows the tapered silver open lattice, glazed main deck, mesh balcony, stepped broadcast arrays and slender antenna tip. Trees hide the lower building.
The closer view shows faceted glazed walls, pale exterior mullions, the radial ribbed underside, crossed braces below the deck, and the mesh enclosure above it.

quallaSearch.notes: Both local Qualla files match exact Commons originals with first-party CC0 dedications. The byline Brücke-Osteuropa redirects to the uploader’s current account, Dr. Bernd Gross. The photos share the 4 April 2011 capture date.
